text:
matt: Heads-up — we're hitting a contract edge case for private VPC tenants in EU that have strict egress allowlists. Someone tried a model routing fallback to a us-east variant and it was dropped by their infra.
jenny: Did the control plane check tenant.allowed_regions before falling back? If not that's the bug.
rahul: Correct — current fallback policy uses 'compatible_model_variants' only. It doesn't consult tenant.egress_policy.
matt: Can we add a quick opt-in field: tenant.egress_consent = true/false and tenant.allowed_regions = [eu-central-1,...]? Want fallback routing to respect those.
maya: We already store allowed_regions for Dedicated. For Private the control plane doesn't enforce at runtime — it's a deploy-time guard. Changing runtime will need telemetry + tenant admin consent flows. Security concerns.
rahul: Security: we can't silently route requests outside allowed_regions. Need API schema suggestion: 
```json
{
  "egress_policy": {
    "allowed_regions": ["eu-central-1"],
    "allow_fallback_to_other_regions": false
  }
}
```
And default to false.
jenny: Proposed internal API: POST /v1/tenants/:id/egress-policy { allowed_regions, fallback_policy } and runtime will consult x-tenant-egress header for decisions.
matt: UX question — how do we expose this in Console? sel: small toggles + 'simulate fallback' wizard. design: can we show expected latency/cost impact when you disable cross-region fallback?
design: mock text: "If fallback is disabled, model variants in other regions won't be used — may increase latency or quota failures. Estimated cost delta: +20%"
maya: Ops note: we need telemetry tags on routed requests: tag 'egress_policy_version', 'egress_effective_region', 'fallback_attempted'. Add to trace and metrics for 30 days.
ops-bot: deploy:controlplane v3.14 queued, will gate on rahul's approval. :thumbsup: 
rahul: I'll review. One more thing — quotas. If fallback is blocked we should increment tenant.metric.failed_fallbacks and surface in console alerts so SREs can preempt capacity requests.
jenny: Agree. Also add small canary rollout in Console: allow 'dry-run' mode where control plane logs what it would have done but doesn't enforce, shown to tenant admins.
matt: ok plan: API + schema, runtime guard, telemetry tags, console canary. I'll write the RFC and a small migration script to populate egress_policy.default=false for existing Private tenants.
sel: thanks — please include copy for the Console modal that explains legal consent and data flow across regions.
matt: will do. tagging this for follow-ups: @maya @rahul @jenny @design. end.
